title: 948. Maximum Width Ramp

examples.explanation: Pairing index 1 (value 0) with index 5 (value 5) spans 4 positions, wider than any other valid pair.
Index 2 (value 1) to index 9 (value 1) gives width 7, the best possible here.
Strictly falling values admit no pair with i < j and nums[i] <= nums[j], so the width is 0.

hints: Candidate left ends are exactly the positions holding new prefix minima.
Keep those minima on a decreasing stack, then match each right end from the far right.
Each index enters and leaves the stack once, giving linear time.
